tei:div.tei:p: (397)mtshon 'bum gyi lag lenathar lam gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ (398)

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang po chos rje mi pham rin po che'i snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can brtse ba'i rjes su gdams pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mchan nor bu'i phreng ba nyams su bstar ba'i phan yon khyad rapa du 'phags pa ste/ ji skad du bstan pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag gi mtshan bzung ba dang mchod pa sogs byas pas ngan song ngan 'gro thams cad las grol zhing : bskal bar gnas pa'i las kyi sgrib pa mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa yang yongs su dag par 'gyur la/ bder 'gror skye zhing rim kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ gal ste dad pa dang dran pa nyams pas sdig pa byed pa/ dam pa'i chos spang pa/ (399) 'phags pa la skur ba 'debs pa/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/ srog gcod pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi nor rku ba dang*/ sems can mnar med pa dang*/ ngan song gsum du skye ba'i sems can gyi don dang*/ grogs po dang gnyen rnams yongs su thar bar bya ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi gzugs sku re mdo'i 'jim pa las byas la mchod pas kyang mchod de sems can de dag thar bar bya ba'i slad du gsol ba btab cing*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag gi ched du bsngo ba byas pas ngan 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ba song phan yon chod med par gsungs pas mtshon phon phyir bstan/ bye brag tu de bzhin gshegs pa re re nas thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi khyad par las phan yon rnams bye brag tu dran par bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rjes su dran pa lags pas/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mtshan 'dzin ni phan yon rgya che la/ deng sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che gnas pa'i (400) dbang gis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'bum gyi bskrun du mi nus pa 'di dag thos kyis/

gzhan du bskal ba bye bar rnyed dka' ba'i 'du shes/ mdud tsam gyis dal 'byor thob nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'jal ba don yod par bya ba'i 'du shed dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi phris sems can gyi yul la spel ba'i 'du shes dang*/ yun gyi don chen po sgrub par bya ba'i 'du shes dang*/ tshogs chung dus bgyi ba rlabs po che sgrub pa'i 'du shes dang*/ rang dbang med par 'khor ba na rgyu ba'i sems can sdug bsngal gyis mun par lag stong du 'khyams pa rnams snying rje chen po'i 'du shes lhan par bskyed la/ sangs rgyas sras bcas 'di dag gi mtshan rang gi 'dzin cing gzhan la 'dzin du 'jug pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bsngags pa yang dag par brjod pa rgya cher bsgrags pa sogs ci nus su 'bad de bya ba dang*/ rang la drin che ba'i pha ma sogs dang byams pas ltos shing gces par bzung ba'i ste 'brel sogs la'ang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'di dag las rang gang la mos pa'i mtshan re re 'am/ (401) gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa bla ma 'dzin du bcug nas rgyun par kho tag gyis shig sangs rgyas yid la gyis shig ces nan tan du bskul pa dang*/ rang la re ltos 'cha' ba'i sems can dag gis kho bos sdig pa sna tshogs bgyis na ji ltar bya zhing 'dri la yang de ltar 'dom pa dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde sgrub pa'i slad du sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi mtshan nas brjod la dad pa bskyed par gyis zhas gdams ngag dang*/ sems can shin tu bskal pa chu zhing klog sogs mi shes pa g.yeng ba che ba sogs dam pa'i chos rgya chen po la 'jug par mi nus pa kyang de tsam la mi nus med cing*/ mtshan rna bar grags pa tsam yang 'brus tshad me dpa'i phan yon dang ldan pa ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzugs kyi le'u las/ sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod na de yang phon chen po yin te sogs nas/

(402) kyai/ rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig gis rdo rje'i khams zhig zos par gyur na de ci tsam du chung ngu zin kyang rdo rje'i khams de zhu bar mi nus te/ de ni gdon mi za bar gnas thams cad las 'das nas 'og ni phyogs su lung bar 'gyur ro/ kyai/ rgyal ba'i sras de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni rdo rje'i chos ma 'dres pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ kyai/ rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes 'dus ma byas pa'i mthar thug par 'gyur ro/ kyai/ rgyal ba'i sras de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ma 'dres pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ zhes pas mtshon tshul 'di la bsam na/ rang gi don shes pa rnams kyi bdag kyang 'di la 'jug gzhan yang tshul 'di ltu la 'god/ gzhan la yang khyed kyi gzhan dag la tshul 'di bzhin bskul ma gyis zhes ci nus su 'dom par bya ste/ de yang rgyas par gos sbyong dang ldan par gnas gtsang mar me tog gi sil ma bkram pa'i (403) maṇḍal ma sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs sogs bzhugs su gsol la/ de'i mdun du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa gtsang mar bshams shing bdag gtsang sgra dang ldan pas stan la 'khod nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems gnyis yid la byas te/ sa gzhi sogs byin rlabs rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas nas/ dair de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs la mchod pa sogs ci ltar rigs pa phul/ kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la rjes su slob pa'i bslo mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang bcas pa'i lus zhing gi rdul rnyed du mngon par brgyud par mos la/ gus pas rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan mang po'am gang 'dodapa re re nas ci nus su brjod/ mthar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs yan lag bdun pa (404) tshul bzhin byas rjes/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dam chen po rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab te skyabs yul rnams rang gnas su gshegs shing dge ba bsngo ba sogs smon lam rgya cher gdab pa ni/

sman mdo'i dgongs pa zhi ba 'tsho'i sman mdo dang*/ gsar rnying gi mkhas grub du mas sman mdo sogs mtshan gsum 'ga' la mdo'i bstan don gyi phyag bzhes gnang bar 'dug bsdu na skyabs sems cam gyi rjes su sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rab 'byams de dag tu sangs rgyas sras bcas de dag tu kyis dmigs la/ de'i zhabs kyi drung du gus pas phyag 'tshal ba sogs dmigs pa'i sgo nas mtshan ci nus su brjod la/ mthar ji snyed su dag ma'i yan lag bdun pa bya zhing smon lam gdab pa dang*/ shin tu bsdu na/ 'gro 'chags nyal 'dug gi skabs su nam dran par dad pa'i sgo nas mtshan brjod pa kho nas don grub po gsungs pas/ 'dir ni phyag len rgyas pa'i dbang du byas te nyams su bstar ba la (405) gsum/ sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i chos dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ dang po la lnga las/ rten bkram pa ni/ rang gi gnas khang phyag dar legs par byas shing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng bu bang rim can no/ stegs gru bzhi pa'i dbus su 'bru'i tshom bu lnga bkod par/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bris 'bur gang rung*/ gsung rten gleng bam/ thugs rten mchod rten nam sa tstsha tsam 'god rgyu yod na bshams pa ni/ 'dus pa mdo'i yan lag gi dkyil 'khor dang mthun pas phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur/ 'dis sa gos sbyong ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ dge ba mtha' dag yan lag gso byed cing*/ sdig pa mtha' dag yan lag sbyong byed pa/ (406) dge gso'i phyir dang sdig pa rnam sbyong phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pas gso sbyongs zhes gsugs so/ ces pas/ gtan khrims dang ldan pa dge bsnyen yan chad kyi gso sbyong blang kha ltung ba phyir bcos kyi go chod cing*/ min kyang dus khrims tsam blang na dge ba'i 'gyur stobs shin tu che bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byung chub sems dpa'i tshogs mngon sum bzhin tu bzhugs par dmigs/

pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag gi ston pa thugs rje chen po mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ rang dbang med par 'khor ba na rgyu ba'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi mun par lag stong du 'khyams pa rnams (407)la snying brtse ba'i phyir dang*/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde sgrub pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can gang la byas pa gzo ba'i phyir dang*/ phangs pa'i sems kyis phan 'dor pa'i sdug bsngal las skyabs pa'i phyir dang*/ byams pa'i sems kyis bde ba la reg par 'dod pa'i phyir gso sbyong nges par blangs bar bya'o/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ de nas/ bde gshegs sras bcas bdag la dgongs/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*/ gzhan gyi nar yang blang mi bya/ 'khrigs pa'i (408)chos kyang mi spyad cing*/ rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra zhing*/ skyon ni mang po nyer bstan pa'i/ chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ khri gdan che mtho mi bya zhing*/ de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ dri dang phreng ba rgyan dang ni/ glu dang gar sogs spang bar bya/ ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang*/ bla med byang chub myur thob shog lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ chos dang byang chub (409)sems dpa'al yi/ tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum/ bzhi pa byang chub kyi sems rnams pa gnyis bskyed pa la rgyu tshad med pa bzhis blo sbyong bani/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad bde dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar bya/

bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyom la gnas par bya'o/ lan gsum gyi blo sbyong nas/ smon 'jug gi sems rnam pa gnyis bskyed pa ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs (410)kyis/ byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ de bzhin du ni bslab pa la/ rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum gyis sems rnam pa gnyis bzunganas/ mjug rang gzhan dga' ba bsgom zhing spro ba'i sems gzeng bstod la/ deng dus bdag tshe 'brus yod/ mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ sangs sras su da gyur deng*/ zhes rang dga' ba bsgom zhing*/ bdag gi de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ spyan sngar 'gro la bde gshegs (411)nyid dang ni/ bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/ lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar byos/ zhes gzhan dga' ba bsgom du bzhugs/ lnga pa sa gzhi dang mchod pa ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ rgyas par/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir 'khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyis zhing gi bkod pa ltung*/ phun tshogs (412)yon tan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa mjes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ru pū ra pu ru pu ra a warta ya a warta ya spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing de dag tu lha dang mi yi yo byad dam pa/ gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya legs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/

zhes nam mkha' mjod kyi sngags rgya dang mchod pa'i sprin gzungs brjod/ bsdu na/ thams cad du yang sa gzhi dag gseg ma la sogs med pa dang*/ lag (413)mthil ltar mnyam baiḍūrya'i/ rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig ces dang gong sngags gnyis brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i tsho ga la/ dang po tshogs kyi zhing gsal 'debs pa ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sku lus las/ 'od kyi 'jig rten gang bar byed pa yi/ mgon po gang gi sku la sems 'jin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' de ni mnyam bzhag yin/ 'chang dang 'dug dang 'gro dang nyal ba na/ mi gang thub pa'i zla ba dran byed pa/ de yi mdun na rtag tu ston pa bzhugs/ de ni rgya cher mya ngan 'da' bar 'gyur/ zhes pas/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ a/ chos rnams rang bzhin mi dmigs stong pa nyid/ rten 'byung 'gag med sgyu ma'i rnam pa ru/ zhing 'di bde ba can gyis snod (414)bcud bzhin/ srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i dpal gyis 'byor/ rin chen sa gzhi ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan/ gser dngul mu tig bye ma gram bur brdal/ sman shing me tog nags dang skyed mos tshal/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan ba bres dang*/ tsanda dri bsung nyi zla'i sgron me dang*/ yid du 'ong ba 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams/ lha ma'i longs spyod kun bzang mchod pas khyab/ der ni yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhal med khang*/ rin chen seng khri padma zla ba'i gdan/ rnam mang bkod pa'i dbus kyi khri steng du/ (415)ston pa thugs rje chen po bcom ldan 'das/ bkrin mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po ni/ gser gyi mdog can mtshan dpe gzi byin 'bar/ 'od kyi 'jig rten kun nas 'geng ba yi/ ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par dag pa'i sku/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gnon mnyam bzhag mjad/ chos gos gsum gsol rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ dran pas srid zhi'i gdung ba rab zhi ba/ de yi mtha' bskor khyams kyi 'khor yug tu/

phyogs bcu'i zhing gi bde gshegs sras dang bcas/ gdan 'jom mngon gsum yid (416)kyi mos pa'i ngor/ nyin byed 'char kha'i mdangs kyis rab 'khyud pa'i/ lhun sdug gser gyi ri bo'i ngos bzhin du/ mthong na mi mthun med pa zhi ba'i sku/ dmar ser 'od kyi phung pa lham me ba/ zhing kun 'gong ba tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung*/ mnyan par 'os shing mi tshungs snyan cing dul/ sems can kun yid mthun par chos ston pas/ 'khor ba'i srid rgyun sdug bsngal 'phrog par byed/ shes bya'i khyon kun ma lus skad cig la/ mkhyen gnyis ye shes dri ma med pa'i thugs/ sna tshogs gdul bya'i khams dang (417)dbang po bzhin/ rtog pa med par re ba skong bar mjad/ chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du sangs rgyas pa/ mkha' ltar mi g.yo ye shes sku mnga' ba/ yon tan kun gyi pha rol son pa yi/ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ rgyal ba rab byung bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ mtshan gyi snyan pa srid mthar rab grags pa/ thos dang dran pas don kun sgrub mdzad pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma lus mngom sum gsal/ rgyal sras rgyal ba'i myu gu rgyal ba'i gzhi/ rgyal byed rtsal ldan blo ldan 'phags pa (418)mchog mtshan gyi grags pas phyogasu na gsal byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnams dang de dag gi thugs rgyud yongs gtam mi zad brgyad cu'i chos/ bsam med gnyis med rnam par mi rtog pa/ dag dang gsal dang gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyi/ gang zhig gang gis chags dang bral byed pa'i/ bden pa gnyis kyi bsdus pa dam pa'i chos/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ chod brjod gleng gzhi rtogs brjod de ltar byung*/ skyes rab rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ gsung rab yi ge po ti'i rnam pa can/ (419)theg pa gsum gyi chos kyi rang sgra sgrogs/ pho brang slad rol rdo rje nag po che/ dpal mgon bdun cu rgyal chen sde bzhi po/

rang rang rigs gyi dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs/ sde dang dpung bcas gzi byin bsam mi khyab/ rang blo mos pa'i yid kyi mngon sum du/ dngas ba'i me long gzugs brnyan shar ba'i/ mkha' dbyings dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rnam bkra ba/ snang la ma 'dres rten 'brel rol par shar/

zhes gsal btab ste/ gnyis pa bsam nams kyi tshogs gsogs pa'i zhing du dad pa'i yid kyis spyan drangs ba ni/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi bu mo rdo rjes/ (420) de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa bsod snyom du spyan drang ba'i tshig ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ bdud sde'i dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad pa/ dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyong shing*/ smon lam rgya cher dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ khyed bzhi 'gro don mjad dus 'di lags na/ de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mjad cing*/ (421)mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ yong dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ dad pa'i spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ tshur byon tshur byon zhi dag la/ thub pa skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ shin tu legs byas gzugs (422)brnyan ni/ mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ zhes dang*/ bzhugs su gsaul ba ni/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ bdag cag bsod nam bskal bar ldan/ bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ bzhi pa srid zhus ste reg gyi sku khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam sogs nas sku khrus gsol/ khrus kyi khang pa sogs nas sku khrus gsol/ oṃ na ma sarba/ de nas sku phyi na bza' 'bul ba ni/ stong gsum kun nas dri ngad ldang ba yi/ dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang gyi sku/ (423)gser sbyang btso ma byi dor byas par ltar/

'od chags 'bar ba de dag byung par bgyi/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ gos bzag srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ rin chen rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dag gi 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi/ lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ mnyam med jo bo rje'i a ti sha'i zhal nas/ tshogs bsags pa'i thabs la/ rab de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' yin pas rang ma ring ngo 'dzin (424) sogs med na yang bden pa'i tshig des tshogs rjogs stobs che la/ 'bring pa bcu'i sems can chen po rgyal tshab byams pa'i smon lam ltu/ sa dang po na bzhugs pa'i dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub lta bu'i gsungs rnams la chod mar bzung dgos la/ gzhan so skye'i gsung tshigs bcad sdeb sbyor la sogs pa yod kyang tshogs rdzogs pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs stobs chung bas dgos pa med par gsungs pa bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas gsung pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa dang*/ bzhi pa re mos dang*/ thub bstod bcas/ kun tu bzang po'i smon lam rjes su slob pa'i blos mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho dang bcas pa'i lus zhing gi rdul snyed kyis mngon par brgyud par mos la gus pa rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis/ bzang spyod kyi ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i sogs nas bdag gis bstod ces par bar dang*/ de nas mtshan 'bum gyi nang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan re re nas phyag 'tshal lo (425) mchod do skyabs su mchi'o zhes sbyar nas rgyun du phan yon rnams bzhag la/ mtshams su rang gi dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa dang*/ gzhan la dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir nyan pa po yod na phan yon tshar re bton na legs/ de ltar mtshan 'bum tshar ci nus su dal bus bklag nas/

de nas/ me tog dam pa sogs nas phyir bsngo'o/ bar btang*/ yan lag bdun pa grangs bsags kyang chog la/ drug pa sangs rgyas kyi thugs dam chen po'i smon lam rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas gzungs bzla ba ni/ sngags bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul te/ sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa mkha' khyab tu spros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la phog pas las (426)dang ma rig pa nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ma lus pa ba mo la nyi zer phog pa ltar sbyang*/ zhi sgo gnyis su med pa rtog 'brel rang bzhin med pa'i don rgyud la skye bar bsamam la/ ta dya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mhā mu ni shākya mu na ye swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs ci nus su bzla'o/ bde bar gshegs pa spyi'i snying po/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya a nu ga te oṃ ku ru gi ni swā hā/ zhes 'di lan gcig bzlas na bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i bar du bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad 'dag par gsungs pas brgya rtsa logs ci nus su bzla'o/ de nas gtang rag gi mchod pa/ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos sogs/ dngos (427)su 'byor dang bdag pos ma bzung ba'i/ lha ma'i yo byad phun sum tshogs rnams dang*/ gzungs dang rig pa'i mthu dang mos stobs kyis/ bskyed pa'i kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho chos/ nam mkha'i khyon kun bkang te 'bul bar bgyi/ bdag gis thog ma med nas tshe rabs su/ nyer bsags sdig ltung ma lus so sor bshags/ rang gzhan skye 'phags kun gyi dus gsum du/ laigs byas bsod nams tshogs la rjes yi rang*/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar bskul/ (428)mya ngan 'da' bzhed 'jig rten sgron me'i tshogs/ kun tu 'gro don mdzad cing bzhugs par 'tshal/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i phung po rnams/ bdag gzhan rdzogs byang thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/

snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs rje lhag par dgongs/ rlabs chen spyod pa smon lam mthar phyin pas/ mtshan tsam 'dzin pas srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog pa/ bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas la bstod/ ces dang */ bdun pa 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ maṇḍal so bdun ma phul te/ yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur bla ma rje/ tshul bzhin brten pa lam gyi rtsa ba ru/ (429)legs par mthong nas 'bad pa du ma yis/ gus pa chen pos brten par byin gyis rlobs/ lan gcig rnyed pa'i dal ba'i rten bzang 'di/ shin tu rnyed dka' don chen shes gyur nas/ nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa'i blo/ rgyun chad med par skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ lus srog g.yo ba chu yi chu bur bzhin/ myur du 'jig pa'i 'chi ba dran pa dang*/ shi ba'i rjes su lus dang grib ma bzhin/ dkar nag las 'bras phyi bzhin 'brang ba la/ nges pa brten po (430)rnyed nas nyes pa'i tshogs/ phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang spong ba dang*/ dge tshogs mtha' dag sgrub par byed pa la/ rtag tu bag dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ spyad pa'i ma ngoms sdug bsngal kun gyi sgo/ yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i phun tshogs kyi/ nyes dmigs rig nas thar ba'i bde ba la/ don gnyer chen po skye ber/ rnam dag bsam pa de yis drang ba yi/ dran dang shes bzhin bag yod chen po yis/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar ba la/ sgrub pa snying por byed par/ rang nyid srid mtshor ltung ba ji bzhin du/ mar gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra bar/ (431)mthong nas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i khur khyer ba'i/ byang chub sems mchog 'byongs bar/ sems tsam bskyed kyang tshul khrims rnam gsum la/ goms pa med na byang chub mi 'grub pa/ legs par mthong nas rgyal sras sdom pa la/ brtson pa drag pos slob par/ log pa'i la la g.yeng ba zhi byed cing*/ yan lag don la tshul bzhin spyod pa yi/ zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam/

myur du rgyud la skye bar/ thun mong lam sbyang snod du gyur pa na/ theg pa kun gyi mchog gyur rdo rje'i theg (432)skal bzang skye bo'i 'jug ngong dam pa der/ bde blag nyid du 'jug par/ de tshe dngos grub rnam gnyis sgrub pa'i gzhi/ rnam dag dam tshig sdom par gsung pa la/ brtsos ma min pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur nas/ srog dang bsdos te bsrung bar/ de nas rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis kyi/ gnad rnams ji bzhin rtogs nas brtson pa yis/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor las mi g.yeng bar/ dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub par/ de ltar lam bzang ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang*/ tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i grogs rnams zhabs brtan cing*/ phyi dang nang gi (433)bar du gcod pa'i tshogs/ nye bar zhi bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ 'phags bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi tshul bzhin bgyis nas/ brgyad pa nongs pa bshags pa ni/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ gang yang bdag rmong blo yis ni/ bgyis pa dang ni bgyid rtsal pa/ dus ngan sems can bsod nams dman/ ma rig nyon mongs dang 'dres pas/ 'phags pa'i thugs dgongs ma rdzogs pa/ de yang bzod par/ ser sna'i dbang gyur mi mkhas pas/ mchod pa ngan zhing bshams nyes pa/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas/ de yang bzod par/ bag med spyod pa ma dag pas/ (434)mdo las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin/ ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa/ de yang bzod par mjad du gsol/ de nas rten yod na bzhugs su gsol zhing med na gshegs su gsol ba ni/ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ rjes su/ sangs rgyas/ slar/ badzra muḥ zhes brjod/ dgu pa shis pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ sogs zhal nas gsungs pa'i shes brjod ci rigs pas mthar brgyan par bya'o/ da ni mdo lugs kyi cho ga dang 'brel ba gshin pa rjes su 'jin pa'i rim pa la/ sbyong rgyud sogs nas byung ba'i sngags kyi cho ga ni 'dir mi 'brel bas/

mdo dang mthun pa'i lag len dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes ltar byed pa la gsum/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzha so/ dang po ni bsham bkod kyi rten dang mchod pa bshams pa lhan gcigatu/ bum pa bya rgyud nyer lnga'i rdzas dang dri bzang gi chus bkang ba gcig maṇḍal kyi dbus su bshams/ (435) gzhan mi byang*/ bgegs gtor/ ril/ bye ma/ yungs khrus chas rnams 'du bya/ cho ga dbu nas dngos gzhi tshangs pa'i bar btang*/ phyag mchod sogs kyi skabs su tsha 'das des kyang pho brang gi slad rol nas phyag mchod byed par bsam pa khyad par ro/ gzungs bzlas pa'i skabs su/ sngags bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung bum chu la thim pas dag byed ye shes kyi chu rgyun du byin gyis brlabs/ bye ma la thim pas sdig sgrib sbyongs byed reg sgrol gyi rdzas su byin gyis rlabs par gyur/ ces mos la gzungs sngags brgya rtsa logs pa ci nus su bzla'o/ gnyis pa cho ga'i dngos gzhi grub nas gtang rag (436) gi mchod bstod kyi mgor ming byang la rten gsal gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa spyan drang ba'i zhabs 'brang du tshe las 'das pa cho ga'i 'di zhes bgyi ba yang phreng gi slad rol du mchis nas gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin thal mo sbyar te tsog pur 'khod par mos te/ rnam shes bkug pa ni/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi/ chos kyi/ dge 'dun gyi khyad par du mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang sa chen po na bzhugs pa'i byang chub (437)sems dpa' sems dpa'i chen po rnams bka'/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum/ skye gnas bzhi/ srid pa rigs drug bar ma do gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig zhes lan gsum brjod/ oṃ shwa dha ni sarba pā paṃ a pa na ya hūm̐/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa a thung gi rnam par bkug pa de nyid rten 'di la thim par gyur/ (438) zhes dang*/ bgegs sbyong ba ni/ mdo lugs la zhi drag gi sbyong ba sbyar ba'i bka' srol medapas/ bgegs gtor la chab bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis rlabs nas/ mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a ba/ zhe lan bdun brjod pas bsngos la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la/ sogs mtshan bzhi brjod nas/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba gson gyi dus su tshe gnas pa dang*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba dang sa dang lam bar du gcod pa mtho ris dang thar ba'i gegs byed pa 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sna 'dren pa lhan gcig skyes pa'i 'dre/ mnyam par 'ong ba'i (439)bdud gnod byed gshed ma'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad la bsngo'o/ sbyin no/ gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gzhan du deng shig ces brjod nas/ de nas sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ mi byang gi mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon tu chu bshams shing*/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad kaṃ yig nag po gyur nas sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par thon te mdun gyis til la thim par dmigs te/ til nag mtheb srin gyi blang la g.yas g.yon lan gsum bskor zhing me chu dor/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da na badzra swā hā/ lan gsum gyi mthar/ tshe las 'das pa'i (440)sdig sgrib thams cad ye shes kyi mos bsreg chos nyid kyi rgya mtshos dag par bsam/

phye ma dang yungs dkar gyi rten la brab cing*/ gong gi sngags gnyis mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs dang bcas bzla/ tshe las 'das pa'i che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig zhes lan gsum brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i sku las 'do zer dpag tu med pa byung nas tshe 'das kyi sdig ltung bag chags dang bcas pa lhag med du sbyang bar bsam mo/ de nas khrus kyi sbyong ba la/ lha khrus bgyi bas sngar rigs sngags kyis btags pa'i chu nyid kyis bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa la khrus gsol bas slar dag byed kyi char byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos pa yod pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang khrus kyi khang pa sogs/ (441)rgyal ba'i sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang*/ tshe 'das las kyi sgrib pa sbyang phyir du/ rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ tshe 'das las kyi sgrib pa sbyangs du gsol/ rgyal ba'i gsung la dri ma mi mnga' yang*/ tshe 'das ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs phyir du/ rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ tshe 'das ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ rgyal ba'i thugs la dri ma mi mnga' yang*/ tshe dpag yid kyi sgribs pa sbyangs phyir du/ rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ tshe 'das yid kyis sgrib (442)pa sbyang du gsol// ///////////////////// (443)'di ni khrus

sogs kyi shwa lo ka ri dang khrus sngags brjod nas/ rgyal ba'i sku la dri ma/ sogs rgyal ba'i gsung la/ sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i thugs la/ sogs dang*/ de bshin gshegs pa rnams dang*/ sogs nas/ sku khrus gsol/ zhes dang*/ de nas ras dkar kha tshar ma nyams pas sku phyi tshul gyis/ bde gshegs sku ni dpe byad mtshan mnga' yang*/ 'gro ba'i don du gzung sku cir yang gda'/ rin chen dbyig ltar nyes pa'i skyon bral yang*/ 'jig rten sri zhu gus pa'i tshul tsam du/ sdig med rgyal ba rnams kyi rab bsngags pa'i/ ras mchog 'di yis rgyal ba'i sku phyis pas/ nyon mongs dug gsum sdig sgrib 'khrud byang nas/ (444)sku gsum ngang du bdag cag myur 'grub shog de nas dri chab kyis byugs pa 'bul tshul gyis/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur bas/ spos mchog rnams kyi thub dbang kun gyi sku/ gser sbyang btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ zhes brjod nas khrus chu slar bum par blug nas/ me long gi ngos su ming byang gi gzugs 'char ba la khrus byed pa ni/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ gtong ba chu yis dag gyur cig khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ gzungs gnyis dang*/ kaṃ ka ni brjod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gdan 'jom pa rnams kyis 'jig rten 'di (445)(446)sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gdan 'jom pa rnams kyis 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du song ba tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang sogs/ pha rol du phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phrin las mjod cig (447)nas pha raul du song ba tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i thog drangs/

sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya ba'i phris las mjod cig de'i 'gre te/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin/ khrims 'chal dri ma/ tshul khrims chu/ khrus legs/ gzungs sngags gnyis dang*/ kaṃ ka ni bzlas te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ sogs nas/ khyad par du tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas tshul khrims kyi phrol (448)du phyin pa yongs su sogs/ 'di ni bzod pa'i/ khong khro'i/ bzod pa/ khrus legs/ gzungs sngags dang*/ kaṃ ka ni bzlas te/ sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs/ khyad par du khong khro'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas bzod pa'i phrol du/ sogs/ 'di ni brtson 'grus/ le lo'i/ brtson 'grus chu/ khrus legs/ gzungs sngags dang kaṃ ka ni bzlas te/ sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs/ khyad par du le lo'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas brtson 'grus kyi/ sogs/ 'di ni bsam gtan/ rnam g.yang*/ bsam gtan/ khrus legs/ gzungs sngags dang kaṃ ka ni brjod/ sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs nas/ khyad par du rnam g.yang gi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas bsam gtan gyi phrol du/ sogs/ 'di ni shes rab/ shes 'chal/ shes rab/ khras legs/ gzungs sngags dang kaṃ ka ni bzlas te/ sangs rgyas dang*/ sogs nas/ (449)khyad par du shes rab 'chal ba'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin/ sogs/ de nas sma byas bya ba te/ dpal 'byin gyi zhus pa'i mdo las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ 'di dag 'dzig rten dug gsum ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ 'dod chags zhe sdang*/ 'di dag bcom ldan dam chos/ dam chos/ 'dod chags zhe sdang*/ 'di dag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun/

dge 'dun/ gzungs sngags rnams brjod nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa'i nyon mongs pa sa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad dag nas dge (450)ba gsum dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ de nas phyi nang gi 'byung ba rnasam nyon mongs pa dug gsum skye ba'i rgyu dang rkyen yin pas de dag gi chos nyid zhi sgo gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid don nges pas/ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhin/ dug gi pha dang ma yang yin/ bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ dug rnams 'byung bzhi'i nang du song*/ gzungs sngags bzlas nas/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skye ba'i nyon mongs pa rgyu rkyen dang bcas pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i don rtogs nas/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa bral bar gyur cig de nas shes pa brjod cing 'di phyi dge legs bya ba ni/ gang la ser sna rnam (451)chags pa/ rnam bcom dri ma med mjad cing*/ thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ 'dren pa gang zhing 'gro ba rnams/ thar ba'i lam du 'jug mdzad phyir/ chos rnams ma lus ston pa des/ khyed la/ ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ gang la bde ba mnga' mjad des/ khyed la/ skyobs pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ thugs kyi 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyang des/ khyed la/ gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ gling dang dpung (452)gnyen gyur pa des/ khyed la/ gang zhig chos kun mngon sum du/ gtsang zhing dri ma mi mnga' la/ gsum gtsang gtsang mar mjad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor cing*/ don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ khyed la/ gang zhig skye bas sa rnams ni/

nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*/ sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ khyed la/ byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*/ bdud yid mi bde gyur pa des/ khyed la/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ 'phags pa'i bden (453)pa rnam gsungs shing*/ thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed la bde legs yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ thams cad chos kyis pham mjad cing*/ tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la/ sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzod/ brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*/ 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyir cig sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yi/ khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ don de de rang 'grub gyur cig rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog rkang bzhi khyed cag (454)khyed cig lam du bde legs shog phyir 'ong dag kyang*/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ nyi ma'i gung yang de legs shing*/ khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnams kyi bden pa'i mthus/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa dang sgribs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal zhing bkra shis par gyur cig de nas mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gror gzhugs pa ni/ ne du yod na ming byang bzung nas phyag byed du gzhugs la/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ stobs chen 'jing pa kun sel ba/ de rang nyid nas skyabs su mchi/ de yi thugs (455)su chud pa'i chos/ 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*/ de bzhin yan lag skyabs su mchi/ 'di ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag nas/ kun tu bzang la 'di nyid 'bul/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag nyid kyi/ lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ thugs rje spyod pa ma 'khrul pa/ spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*/

nyams thag nga ros 'od do 'bod/ sdig ldan 'di la skyabs du gsol/ 'phags pa' nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ thugs rje che mgon thams cad la/ skyabs tshol snying nas 'od dod 'bod/ (456)gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi/ pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byor byed pa/ rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das/ da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas/ khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi/ 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di nyid dus 'di nas bzung sate byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa thugs rje can rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par dzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs ston 'khor gdan 'jom pa de dag gi (457)thugs rgyun na bzhugs pa dam pa'i chos dri ma med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ thugs rje dang ldan pa mkhyen pa dang ldan pa ye shes dang ldan pa/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis tshe las 'das pa 'di yi sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ sems ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal du gsol/ ye shes kyi sgron me bstan du gsol/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i 'khrul snang bsal du gsol/ bar do'i sdug bsngal las skyabs tu gsol/ thab dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam yan lag pa bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par (458)mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'og tu tshud nas/ de dag gi sku las 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa byung*/ tshe 'das la phog sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyang nas bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid rtogs bar do'i 'khrul snang zhi nas thar ba'i lam rjes su dran par dmigs/

de nas 'dod yon bsngo ba ni/ sdig pa dang ma 'dres pa'i bza' btung bsham te/ chab bran nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis thugs rje dang byin rlabs gyi mthu dang bdag gis phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa long pa dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i bsod nams rnams rnams dang smon lam dang rigs sngar kyis stobs bla na med pa'i (459)stobs kyis bsham pa'i rdzas 'di dag 'dod pa'i yon tan zad mi shes pa/ tshe 'das kyi dbang po drug gi yul du ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa dus 'di nas bzung te byang chub kyi bar du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa sogs lan bdun gyi bsngos te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la/ sogs mtshan bzhin brjod nas/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro/ reg dang chos kyi khyad par ci mchis pa/ mos blos blangs te tshe 'das khyed la 'bul/ bkres skom phongs pa'i sdug bsngal kun bral nas/ zag pa (560)med pa'i dbang po drug thob cing*/ rnam grol 'phags pa'i chos la longs spyod nas/ dag pa'i zhing mchog rjes su dran par shog oṃ rū pa shabta gandhe ra sa sparshe dharma ka ma gu ṇa a hūm̐/ thams cad nam mkha' mjod sogs brjod nas/ 'dod yon gyi sems tshim nas gang la chags pa med pa'i sems skye nas dag pa'i zhing khams rjes su dran par dmigs te/ de nas lam bstan pa ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba/ dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis/ rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa/ tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam/ bla na med pa (461)khyad par lam/ byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ brten nas sdig pa kun byang nas/ 'phags pa'i lam dor 'gro bar shog oṃ ratne ratne mhā ratne/

ratna saṃ bha wa/ ratna ki ra ṇe/ ratna mā la bi shuddhe sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ tshe 'das kyi sgo gsum 'od dkar po'i rnal 'byor zhu nas a dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam pa can de nyid phreng gi dbus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs kar 'phos te dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag te/ oṃ padme padme padma ud bha we mhā shuddha kṣa ṭa gatstshantu swā hā/ (462) zhes brjod/ de nas ming byang bsregs pa ni/ stong nyid dbyings kyi kong bu ru/ rang byung ye shes me 'bar bas/ gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i bag chags bsreg sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog ces gzungs sngags khyad par can brjod bzhin pas bsreg nas thal bas patstsha gda' bar bya'o/ mi 'khrugs pa'i mdo las ming byang la sngags bzlas pa'i phye mas reg gam/ patstsha tsam grub na ngan song gi skye sgo kheg par gsung ba'i phyir ro/ de nas bzang spyod smon lam rgya cher bya'o/ de nas che ge mo'i mjug gi bya ba rnams mthar rgyas su bya'o/ de ltar bslu ba med pa sangs rgyas kyi/ mdo sde rtogs pa rnams nas legs bstan pa/ kho che rten cung dam pa rim brgyud kyi/ phyag bzhes 'khrul pa med pa 'di kho na/ zhes rje btsun 'jam pa'idabyangs dang zhal gnyis su med pa mi pham 'jam dpal dgyes pas (463)(464)de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs mdo sde phal mo che nas bstan pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan 'bum nor bu'i phreng ba'i phyag len kha 'phang ba'i dgongs don dang mi 'gal ba 'di ni sgrub pa mchog la brtson pa'i bla ma dam pa 'gyur med kyi snga phyi bskul pa don yod pa'i phyir shākya'i dge slong tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sug bris su bltar ba dge zhing legs pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /
